reason: The numbers are right, but the conclusion and the action are out of date. Every cited figure matches the records: I-047 gives -0.0129/-0.0273; the fork-removal oracle is +0.0063; the missing-node pool is <= +0.029 with 80% multi-frame runs (I-113); I-293 is +0.0059; I-294 is refuted; the combo oracle is +0.0143 like-for-like, 1.19x of the +0.012 bar, with a realistic +0.00039 in-sample and <= 0 out of sample (CONTEXT l.2347, l.2368-2379; combo_oracle/answer.json). So the claim that no inference-only mechanism clears the +0.012 lab bar holds. The problem is timing. The scan file (round12/scan_hyp_private_read.json) was written at 20:09:56 UTC. After that, CONTEXT records three user decisions: at 20:30 UTC the user asked to reach 0.955+ and the reach0955 workflow was launched; at 20:33 UTC the user LIFTED R7, so public-LB probes on K2 variants are allowed with slots at the session's discretion, and changed the FINALS STRATEGY to one final aimed at public (the best public-scoring variant) and one aimed at private (default #37); at 20:34 UTC the user said to execute the reach0955 plan overnight (commits 620f718 and 9ead9df). This makes R12P-8's 'no finals-strategy change', 'no slot' and 'Finals stay #37 + #38' false as a plan. The public-aimed slot is now open; #38, the twin at 0.953, is by definition not the best public variant; and existing K2 patches are now submittable as public probes. One example is reach0955/r_ladder.json L1-exp70a, K2 + leaf prune 0.3: it is +0.00083 in the lab over 51/56 clips with both embryos positive, P36 beat #35 unrounded on public, and the expected gain is +0.0000..+0.0003, enough to flip the display to 0.955. Such a probe is judged on the public read, not on the +0.012 lab bar that the finding uses to close everything. Leaf prune is on the finding's own closed list, which shows that list was drawn up under the pre-20:33 R7 regime. The finding also drops two open items: the R9 retraining go/no-go (reach0955/r_retrain.json, a distilled secondary fine-tune, feasible, E[dPublic] ~+0.0005, needs an explicit R9 lift) and a rule conflict. r_ladder's L9 says 'the twin #38 always stays', while the user's 20:33 decision says 'one for public, one for private'. The main session has to settle that, and an info item that says 'finals stay #37 + #38' would hide it.
